pairs.subject: embedded-preview
pairs.evidence: apps/console/src/pages/onair/Screen.tsx:5 The On Air screen preview is built by composing first-party stage-kit React components inside the console's own tree. A case-insensitive search for iframe, postMessage, contentWindow and event.origin/targetOrigin found nothing in apps/console/src or anywhere under apps/. With no guest app behind its own server, no frame and no cross-frame bridge, the subject's precondition does not hold (the golden path excludes same-origin first-party embeds by name).

techniques.evidence: apps/console/src/pages/onair/Screen.tsx:5 No frame message channel exists. The preview is direct component composition.
apps/console/src/pages/onair/Screen.tsx:5 No inbound or outbound messages cross a frame, so there is no origin to check. In this context 'origin' only appears as the CSS property transform-origin.
